This data set contains twenty-five (25) scans of the Transmitter Station, Herschel Island. All data was captured by the Capture2Presev team.  Fourteen (14) scans were collected on the exterior and eleven (11) scans of the interior with the Lieca BLK 360 on the 10th July, 2019 and registered with AutoDesk ReCap Mobile and Pro V.6.1.
